name: rung2_transfer_penalty
claim: Transfer penalty (cross_platform - in_platform) per baseline, first valid computation. Every real baseline loses 0.17-0.53 of correlation moving from Tahoe-fit to L1000-fit maps: knn -0.379, nmf -0.348, pca -0.189, observed_delta -0.379. planted (positive control) also drops sharply (-0.530), showing part of this is a genuine platform-representation gap the pipeline cannot fit around, not purely a baseline-capacity limit.
